paper.central_claim: 提出 ADAS 并用 Meta Agent Search：元 agent 在已发现 agent 的档案基础上迭代以代码编写新 agent，在 ARC、DROP、MGSM、MMLU、GPQA 上发现显著优于手工设计的 agent，且可跨域、跨模型迁移。
paper.title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems

evidence.quote: a meta agent iteratively programs interesting new agents based on an ever-growing archive of previous discoveries.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心机制：元 agent 以代码形式迭代设计新 agent，依赖不断增长的已发现 agent 档案。

evidence.quote: most of them focus only on designing prompts
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对已有 ADAS 工作的缺口：多数只设计提示。

evidence.quote: While these works share similar motivations to learn more components in agents, they either fail to cover all possible designs in agentic systems or have harder search spaces for search algorithms.
evidence.support_explanation: 对 AgentOptimizer/Agent Symbolic Learning/AutoFlow 等近邻的缺口界定：覆盖设计不全或搜索空间更难——属断言，未做同搜索预算对照。

evidence.quote: The generated agent is evaluated using validation data from the target domain.
evidence.support_explanation: 选择数据=目标域验证集。

evidence.quote: If errors occur during evaluation, the meta agent performs a self-reflection step to refine the design, repeating this process up to five times if necessary.
evidence.support_explanation: 运行错误时最多 5 次自反思修复。

evidence.quote: Finally, the agent is added to the archive along with its evaluation metrics
evidence.support_explanation: 每个生成的 agent（含差的）连同指标进入档案，档案无淘汰/回退规则。

evidence.quote: We sample a validation set and a test set with 20 and 60 questions, respectively, for searching and testing.
evidence.support_explanation: ARC：验证 20 题/测试 60 题（easy 5×5 子集）。

evidence.quote: For GPQA (Science), we use GPQA_diamond and the validation set consists of 32 questions, while the remaining 166 questions form the test set. For the other domains, the validation and test sets are sampled with 128 and 800 questions, respectively.
evidence.support_explanation: 推理域：验证 128/测试 800（GPQA 32/166）。搜索用验证集、报告用测试集。

evidence.quote: We evaluate agents five times for GPQA and once for the other domains to maintain a consistent total number of evaluations.
evidence.support_explanation: 除 GPQA 外每个 agent 只评测一次。

evidence.quote: Meta Agent Search runs for 30 iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: 推理域搜索 30 次迭代（ARC 为 25）。

evidence.quote: Prompt Optimization ( Yang et al., 2024 ) 69.1 ± 0.9
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻基线 OPRO 式提示优化：阅读理解 69.1。

evidence.quote: Meta Agent Search (Ours) 79.4 ± 0.8

evidence.support_explanation: 最强手工基线之一：数学 LLM Debate 39.0±3.4（对比搜索得 53.4）。

evidence.quote: median accuracy and the 95% bootstrap confidence interval on a held-out test set by evaluating agents five times.
evidence.support_explanation: ARC：测试集中位准确率+95% bootstrap CI，每 agent 评测 5 次。

evidence.quote: We test the top 3 agents with the best test accuracy evaluated with GPT-3.5 on ARC and then transfer them to Claude-Haiku
evidence.support_explanation: ARC 迁移的"前 3 名"按测试准确率选取，再在同一测试题上换模型评测——选择集与测试集重合。

evidence.quote: We evaluate the top 3 agents from MGSM by transferring them to
evidence.support_explanation: MGSM 的前 3 名（选择依据未说明）迁移到 GSM8K/GSM-Hard/MMLU/DROP。

evidence.quote: Dynamic Role-Playing Architecture 53.4 ± 3.5 \mathbf{53.4\pm 3.5} 69.5 ± 3.2 \mathbf{69.5\pm 3.2} 31.2 ± 3.2 \mathbf{31.2\pm 3.2} 62.4 ± 3.4
evidence.support_explanation: 最优 MGSM 代理迁移到 MMLU 得 62.4±3.4，低于 CoT 的 65.4——"跨非数学域全面领先"不成立；迁移到 GSM8K 69.5 vs 最佳基线 43.6 为强正面结果。

evidence.quote: Meta Agent Search consistently outperforms the baselines
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对 Table 2 的概括。

evidence.quote: Meta Agent Search (Empty Initialization) 73.9 ± 0.9
evidence.support_explanation: 空档案起步仍超过手工基线（数学 67.5 反而高于带种子的 53.4），是对"人工种子"的单点消融，不是对"档案机制"的消融。

evidence.quote: costs approximately $500 USD in OpenAI API costs
evidence.support_explanation: 一次 ARC 搜索+评测约 500 美元；推理域一次约 300 美元（同附录）。

evidence.quote: A single run of search and evaluation on ARC
evidence.support_explanation: 报告的是单次搜索运行，无多次搜索的方差。

evidence.quote: Currently, we only evaluate Meta Agent Search on single-step QA tasks in this paper.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认只评测单步 QA。

evidence.quote: Higher-order ADAS. Since the meta agent used in ADAS to program new agents in code is also an agent, ADAS can become self-referential where the meta agent can be improved through ADAS as well.
evidence.support_explanation: 改进 meta agent 本身只是未来工作——本文无 improver 级证据。

evidence.quote: the design of the search algorithm is relatively simple, focusing solely on exploring interesting new designs.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认搜索算法简单，未与 QD/开放式算法或随机采样对照。

evidence.quote: all baseline implementations were developed using the same framework as the Meta Agent
evidence.support_explanation: 基线同框架重实现——框架一致，但未声明推理预算/调用次数匹配。

evidence.quote: an important design pattern emerged in iteration 3 where it uses multiple COTs to generate possible answers, refines them, and finally ensembles the best answers.
evidence.support_explanation: 案例：迭代 3 出现的设计成为后续垫脚石——作者的叙事性证据，无档案消融。

evidence.quote: Your goal is to maximize the specified performance metrics by proposing interestingly new agents.
evidence.support_explanation: 元 agent 目标：最大化性能指标并提出"有趣的新"设计，新颖性由 LLM 自反思判定。

evidence.quote: containerized execution of all generated code in secure, isolated environments
evidence.support_explanation: 生成代码在容器内执行并人工检查（安全边界）。
CoT 基线：阅读 64.2、数学 28.0、多任务 65.4（MMLU 比较用）。

evidence.quote: starting from scratch resulted in superior performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 数学域空档案起步优于带种子，说明种子与档案的作用并不单调。
